# AMZN close on 2026-10-12: research brief (as of 2026-09-14)

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the Yahoo Finance daily close for AMZN on 2026-10-12, which is a Monday and a normal trading day. I could not fetch Yahoo directly because the proxy refused the connection.
- 2026-09-11: AMZN closed at $256.78, up 1.94% (open $254.09, high $257.59, low $253.14). The supplied code data and [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/amzn/history/) / [StatMuse](https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/amazon-stock-price-history-2026) match.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The target is about 21 trading days away, and the stock sits near the middle of the 150-350 range.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-11: Shares rose about 1.9%. I found no news explaining the move. [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/amzn/history/)
- 2026-09-07: Shares traded around $258.84 intraday (range about $255.5 to $260.6). [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/equities/amazon-com-inc)
- About 2026-09-02: A Yahoo Finance piece said AMZN was roughly 11% below its August all-time high and had closed below its 100-day moving average. One Polymarket mirror put the late-August highs near $272-278; I could not verify that. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/article/amazon-stock-just-entered-the-danger-zone-104050035.html)
- 2026-08-31: The FTC and 22 states sued Amazon in W.D. Washington. They allege that for 7+ years Amazon inflated ad-auction prices using an "invented auction participant." Reuters reported harm of $20B or more, with "tens of billions" in damages sought. Amazon denies the claims. Shares fell as much as 4.6% intraday. Separately, the 2023 FTC antitrust case goes to trial in 2027. [Stateline](https://stateline.org/2026/08/31/feds-and-22-states-sue-amazon-alleging-deceptive-advertising-scheme/), [The Star/Reuters](https://www.thestar.com.my/tech/tech-news/2026/09/01/amazon-sued-by-ftc-and-over-20-us-states)
- 2026-07-30: Q2 results came in above estimates. AWS revenue grew 37% to $42.2B, the fastest pace in 18 quarters, with a 39.4% margin. Q3 revenue guidance was $197-202B and operating income guidance $22.5-26.5B, a bit below consensus. 2026 capex was raised to about $220B, and trailing free cash flow was reported at about -$7.6B. Sources disagree on the next-day move (about 7% vs 15.3%), and these are secondary or AI-generated sites. [BingX](https://bingx.com/en/news/post/amazon-amzn-q-earnings-overview-aws-growth-drives-a-rally), [SentiSense](https://app.sentisense.ai/stories/amazon-stock-surges-7-percent-on-q2-earnings-beat-37-percent-aws-growth-07302026)
- August 2026: Some analysts set Buy-rated targets: Rosenblatt $335, Wells Fargo $338, TD Cowen $350. [MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/AMZN/forecast/)

## 4. Base rates and typical variation
- The code-computed empirical distribution for 21 trading days ahead (3 years of history, last year double-weighted) gives:
  - p5 $223.7, p10 $231.9, p25 $247.7, p50 $262.9, p75 $274.8, p90 $289.4, p95 $297.1.
  - The median implies a drift of about +2.4%.
  - The p25-p75 band is about -3.5% to +7%.
  - The p5-p95 band is about -13% to +16%.
- Recent trend: a rally after Q2 earnings to an August record, then a pullback of about 11% by early September after the FTC suit. Since then the stock has steadied in roughly the $255-260 range.
- I could not find a current implied-volatility figure for AMZN options.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket runs weekly and daily AMZN price markets, such as "AMZN week of September 11, 2026" and "AMZN close above 255 on September 1." I saw them only through third-party mirrors, which showed thin volume and inconsistent bracket odds.
  - Note that these markets resolve on Pyth 1-minute data, not the Yahoo close.
  - I found no market for 2026-10-12 itself. [struct.to mirror](https://explorer.struct.to/markets/amzn-close-above-255-on-september-1-2026), [polyguana](https://polyguana.com/market/2071797)
- I found nothing on Kalshi or Manifold for this date.
- Sell-side 12-month targets, mostly in the mid-$300s, sit well above the current price. They are not 1-month forecasts.

## 6. Upcoming events before 2026-10-12
- 2026-09-15/16: FOMC meeting. The fed funds rate is 3.50-3.75%. Previews were split between a hold and a 25bp hike: one Kalshi-based piece put a hike at 57%, another source put a hold at 58%. July CPI was 3.4% year over year, and the July vote was 9-3 with three members favoring a hike. A hawkish surprise is a risk for megacap tech. [ATFX](https://www.atfx.com/en-au/analysis/financial-events/september-fomc-meeting-2026-is-a-rate-hike-on-the-table), [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/fed-rate-hike-uncertainty-grows-ahead-of-september-meeting/)
- Late September: Amazon usually holds a fall devices event. I did not confirm a 2026 date.
- Early October: September jobs and CPI reports, plus any legal steps in the FTC ad-auction case.
- 2026-10-06/07: Prime Big Deal Days. [aboutamazon.com](https://www.aboutamazon.com/md/news/retail/amazon-prime-big-deal-days-faq)
- Q3 earnings are typically in late October, so most likely after 2026-10-12. I did not confirm the date. Pre-earnings positioning and peer reports could still move the stock.
